name: Posh Pet Salon by Adore | Pet Grooming in Sharjah
address: al wathbah building - shop no 3 - 3 St - Al Khan - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Posh, a luxury pet salon in the heart of Sharjah, offers a professional yet gentle grooming experience for your beloved pet. Our fully trained staff ensures a high level of hygiene and provides a tranquil, luxurious spa experience. If you're seeking pet grooming in Sharjah, either dog grooming or cat grooming , we cater to all your needs. As a leading pet salon in Sharjah, Posh is dedicated to delivering exceptional care. Trust us for your pet's grooming needs at the finest pet grooming salon.

reviews.author: Anushka Anu
reviews.text:
We visited this shop on Sunday with our three cats, and it was a really nice experience. The groomer (mark) was very friendly, sweet, and welcoming from the moment we arrived. He mentioned that it had been a very busy and tiring day with many dogs and cats to handle, but despite that, he stayed patient and kind throughout.

The shop itself was cute,, and had a comforting atmosphere, You can tell he genuinely cares about the pets he works with. Overall, a lovely experience and we would definitely come back again. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Jenice Pinlac
reviews.text:
We arrived 10 minutes before closing time, and they still happily accepted our booking. Mark (the groomer) welcomed us with a smile, and during a short chat, I found out they were fully booked for the whole day and he was the only groomer available. Despite being tired and having a busy schedule, he accommodated us and groomed our furbaby carefully and neatly. I truly appreciate his hard work and dedication.

I also want to say thank you to the owner, who genuinely cares for her customers and their pets. I’ve been their customer since they had a shop in Al Qusais, which was closer to our place, and even now that they have transferred to Al Khan. Although it’s a bit far from us, we still keep coming back because of the quality of service they provide.

Highly recommended for pet owners who want genuine care, patience, and excellent grooming service. We’ll definitely continue coming back.
